fusions.name: Textbook Chop
fusions.desc: An overhead chop that deals 30 damage and is always a critical hit. It leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Clean Finish
fusions.desc: Throws a hatchet at an enemy at or below 25% health for 18 damage, rising to 1.5 times that damage at its full 5 tile reach.

fusions.name: Drilled Hands
fusions.desc: Increases your attack speed by 25% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Woodpile Rhythm
fusions.desc: Every hit you land builds a stack on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you deal 6% more damage per stack, 36% at full, for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
